description: Three interest-on-drawings items using average-period rule. 12 equal monthly withdrawals; rate stated p.a.

expected_numeric_items.description: Rs. 1,000 at the BEGINNING of every month for 12 months; 6% p.a. Avg period 6.5 months. I = 12000 x 6% x 6.5/12.
Rs. 2,000 at the END of every month for 12 months; 9% p.a. Avg period 5.5 months. I = 24000 x 9% x 5.5/12.
Rs. 5,000 monthly, DATES NOT GIVEN; 8% p.a. Avg period 6 months. I = 60000 x 8% x 6/12.

notes: These three cover the three standard CBSE sub-cases. Matches the rule stated in test_generator_service.ACCOUNTANCY_CORRECTNESS_RULES L1274.
